Z's eigenvalues: +1 (eigenvector |0>), -1 (eigenvector |1>)

measuring Z can only return +1 or -1
result +1 -> state collapses to |0>
result -1 -> state collapses to |1>
caption: This is the mathematical reason a qubit measurement is binary — the outcomes are literally which eigenvector the state collapsed into.
The probability of each outcome is the squared amplitude on the matching eigenvector.
